moments.title: She knew nothing about insurance or mutual funds when she started
moments.summary: A participant who introduces herself in the transcript as Malika Singhamia says she knew nothing about basic things like insurance and mutual funds when she began, and that her girlfriends think they know but do not.
moments.evidence: When I started I didn't know anything about basic things like insurance, mutual funds.

moments.title: She understands financial terms so much better now
moments.summary: She says the course opened up what had felt like a closed world, and that she now understands financial terms and her own financial literacy far better.
moments.evidence: I truly feel like I understand financial terms so much better, my financial literacy so much better.

moments.title: Taking control of her own money, and her husband's
moments.summary: She says that once she finishes the course she expects to be able to take control of her money, and her husband's money too.
moments.evidence: I feel like once I finish this course I'm going to be able to take control of my money and also my husband's money very soon.
